title: Robinhood Hyperspeed
style: Heist, jail break, hyper speed phonk, cowbell, fast drift music, dark high energy beats, transition to 90s R&B outro
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Fast-paced police radio chatter)
"Unit 336, we have a visual on the suspect. Blacked out mansion, moving fast. Suspect is at hyperspeed. Engage pursuit!"

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

[Verse 1]
Cash back drop
What a shock
Chase and cage
Free birds rock

Maths driver
Delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed I can 
You got this
We believe

[Build-up]
Math Driver
3 Mirrors
Phonk track bounce

[Verse 2]
Heres my boys
Thrash this toy
Take the right lane
Hyper speed plane

[Skit]
(Police chatter)
"Sirens sound! Unit 336! A robin, a robin out of the mansion!"

[Verse 3]
Fake a break
Chase and cage 
Extra stripe
For no rage

[Chorus]
A robin in hood!
But its for good!
Bust em like we should
Ha bro, if we could!

[Bridge]
You heard the sarg
Chase and cage
Thrash this toy
Catch that boy

Phonky sneaky phonk
Thrift drift kick 
Give them rage
In our cage

[Outro: 90s R&B Soulful Style]
Math Driver
The architect
The plan 
The dream
Done safe 
Done sound
Our robin
Our robin
Our robin
In our hood...
(Smooth fading R&B ad-libs)
